about:
ITW Food Equipment Group is headquartered in Troy, Ohio, and traces its roots to 1830 when the Bonnet brand began designing, manufacturing, and installing professional kitchen equipment in Europe. The group operates as a division of Illinois Tool Works (ITW), bringing together a family of premium brands that have served foodservice and food retail professionals for over a century.

The company designs and manufactures a broad range of commercial cooking, refrigeration, warewashing, and bakery equipment under brands including Hobart, Traulsen, Baxter, Vulcan, Wolf, Stero, Foster, and Bonnet. Its innovation pipeline has produced nearly 600 ENERGY STAR® certified products, driven by more than 1,000 staff members who hold at least one invention and a 70% patent commercialization rate reported in 2013. A service network of nearly 200 offices and 1,500 factory-trained technicians covers 95% of customers within 50 miles, complemented by the SmartConnect365 remote-monitoring platform.

ITW Food Equipment serves the foodservice, food retail, bakery, and institutional catering sectors, including restaurants, hotels, schools, and healthcare facilities. Wholesale and production bakery suppliers also rely on its equipment for high-volume operations.

The group emphasizes customer-driven innovation and sustainable leadership, earning the U.S. EPA’s ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year award every year since 2008 and the Sustained Excellence Award in 2024. Brands such as Foster have achieved the Carbon Trust Standard for carbon reduction, while technologies like Hobart’s Advansys energy recovery system cut energy costs by up to 50% and water use by 90% in dishwashing.

name: IWG High Performance Conductors
old_description: International Wire Cable Services offers a comprehensive range of wire products, including bare and tinned copper wires, as well as tinned and stainless steel braids, tailored to meet diverse industry needs.
about:
International Wire, headquartered in Camden, New York, traces its origins to 1885. The company has grown through strategic acquisitions to become the largest non-vertically integrated manufacturer of copper and copper-alloy wire products in the United States.

The company produces copper single-end wire (44 AWG to 2 AWG), stranded wire, braided wire, flat wire, and copper wire on bobbins. Its in-house capabilities cover the full fabrication chain: drawing, stranding, bunching, bobbin winding, braiding, cable over-braiding, and custom harness braiding. International Wire describes its portfolio as thousands of products serving diverse industrial applications.

Customers span advanced manufacturing and automation, electrification and power infrastructure, aerospace and defense systems, data centers and critical connectivity, transportation and e-mobility, smart living and appliances, energy extraction and processing, healthcare and medical devices, and built environment and infrastructure. Specific applications include robotics, factory automation, solar farms, wind turbines, nuclear energy, in-flight entertainment and cabin management wiring, airframe conductors, 5G network infrastructure, electric vehicle systems, medical devices, and building wiring and grounding.

International Wire states its mission is to provide quality, value-oriented, copper-based products and services that exceed customer expectations, guided by core values of safety, people, customers, products and services, integrity, and continuous improvement. The company emphasizes its decades of experience in wire drawing, conductor fabrication, and custom wire solutions as a differentiator.

name: Icon Metals Machining & Fabrication
old_description: From custom fabrication to CNC machining, Icon Metals delivers superior quality and exceptional service for all your metal manufacturing needs.
about:
Icon Metals Machining & Fabrication operates from Freedom, Wisconsin, a community in Outagamie County. The company was founded in 2016, emerging from a predecessor business known as Mike's Welding. The rebranding marked an expansion of capabilities while retaining a focus on craftsmanship.

The shop provides CNC machining, fabrication, tube laser cutting, structural steel fabrication, gear and sprocket hobbing, and tube bending. Equipment includes a Hurco VM2 CNC mill, a Kia Super Turn 21 CNC lathe, a Dianichi F250 CNC lathe, and a BLM LT8 tube laser capable of processing up to 8-inch square or 23-pounds-per-foot material. The facility employs 13 people and has completed more than 15,000 projects since inception.

The company serves customers requiring custom metalwork across a range of industries, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials. Its service list suggests relevance to industrial equipment, agricultural machinery, and structural construction markets.

Icon Metals states its goal is to exceed customer expectations through superior welding, fabrication, tube lasering, bending, and machining services, positioning itself as a partner with an emphasis on exceptional customer service. The business highlights ten years in business and a single mission to deliver quality.

name: Icon Modern
old_description: + years in custom fabrication, we have learned how to make custom products more accessible to designers by creating a streamlined, easy process and offering a wider range of materials and capabilities than most custom shops. The majority of our materials are sourced locally and we fabricate everything in our hometown of Chicago.
about:
Icon Modern was founded in 2007 in Chicago, Illinois, by Rocky Levy and Aaron Tvrdy. The pair met after Levy read a Chicago Tribune article about thousands of urban trees being removed due to disease; drawing on his background in commercial furniture, he envisioned turning that waste into sustainable furniture.

The company operates as a full-service custom fabricator, producing conference tables, community tables, reception desks, space dividers, ceiling elements, feature walls, planters, and countertops. Its shop works with urban hardwoods, steel, stone, glass, and composite panels, offering CNC machining, welding, powder coating, veneering, and stone fabrication. A team of architects, designers, and project managers handles engineering, value engineering, shop drawings, 3D renderings, and prototyping, overseeing each project from concept through installation.

Icon Modern serves interior designers, architects, and end-users in commercial office, hospitality, retail, and technology sectors. Past clients include Starbucks, Whole Foods, Twitter, Caterpillar, IPG, and Jump Trading, with projects ranging from boardroom tables with integrated power to large-scale ceiling installations and moss walls.

The firm differentiates itself through a streamlined, collaborative process, a broad material palette sourced within a 100-mile radius, and a commitment to sustainability that diverts urban lumber from landfills. It imposes no minimum or maximum order quantities and emphasizes shorter lead times through in-house capabilities.

about:
Icon Solar is based in Milford, Ohio, and was founded in 2009. The company serves the tri-state region of Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana, focusing on residential and commercial solar installations.

The company provides turnkey solar installation services, handling system design, permitting, installation, and grid connection. It partners with manufacturers such as Franklin WH, Enphase, and Tesla to supply battery storage equipment, and offers solar financing options. Icon Solar describes itself as one of the largest residential installers in the region, though it does not disclose facility size or headcount.

Icon Solar serves residential homeowners and commercial businesses across Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana. It participates in solar programs conducted by various cities in the region and is a referral partner for Duke Energy's "Find It Duke" program. The company references rising rates from utilities such as Duke Energy, AES, and AEP as a driver for customer adoption.

Icon Solar differentiates itself by performing all installations in-house without subcontractors, offering 25-year warranties on both panels and inverters, and using module-level power electronics (MLPE) to maximize production. The company highlights its A+ BBB rating with zero complaints and a 4.8 out of 5.0 Google rating as indicators of reliability.

The company produces custom indoor and outdoor furniture in styles that include farmhouse, modern, mission, and live-edge river tables. about:
Idaho Livin was founded in 2017 in Boise, Idaho. The company operates a retail storefront in the Clearwater Building downtown, open seven days a week. Ownership structure and founder names have not been publicly disclosed.

The brand designs and prints its own line of graphic tees, retro and trucker hats, fleece shorts, and women’s apparel, all marketed for Idaho summers. Production is handled in-house at the Boise location, allowing the company to ship stocked items the next business day. The operation serves over 17,000 customers since launch, though facility size and headcount are not published.

Idaho Livin sells directly to consumers through its store and website, catering to outdoor enthusiasts and tourists seeking Idaho-themed apparel. A “Custom Apparel” section suggests the company also provides decorated garments for groups or businesses, though specific B2B industries or client examples are not detailed.

The company emphasizes its local roots—“Designed & printed in Idaho”—and fast fulfillment from Boise as key differentiators. Free shipping on orders above $75 and a physical retail presence reinforce a community-focused model built around the state’s outdoor lifestyle.

old_description: Since 1995 we have used your tubes and had great success. Long-lasting, and you have always delivered on time. Thanks for making everything in the USA.
about:
Idaho Sewing for Sports was founded in 1974 in Grangeville, Idaho, by Will and Gail Williams. What began as a small local business sewing truck seats has grown into a woman-owned, Idaho-based manufacturer of protective padding.

The company designs and manufactures custom safety padding for ski areas, athletic facilities, playgrounds, and adventure parks. Operating from its Idaho facility, the team produces thousands of pads annually using heavy-duty UV-resistant vinyl and high-density foam. All products are made in the USA and shipped globally, with the company serving more than 600 ski areas worldwide.

Customers include ski resorts such as Brooks Lake Lodge and Four Seasons Ski Center, schools, recreation centers, stadiums, climbing gyms, ropes courses, and amusement parks. The company specializes in custom-fitted solutions for lift towers, wall pads, column pads, and unique structures, offering custom colors and logos.

The company's stated mission is to keep athletes, adventurers, and children safe. In 2022 it introduced the industry's first 100% recyclable padding line, reflecting a commitment to sustainability. Idaho Sewing emphasizes personal customer service, with padding experts guiding each project from quote through design, manufacturing, and delivery.

name: Idaho Supreme Potatoes Inc.
old_description: Idaho Pacific Holdings, Inc. is a family of potato dehydration companies spanning North America – from the nutrient rich farmlands of Idaho to the San Luis Valley of Colorado to the red sandy soils of Prince Edward Island, Canada.
about:
Idaho Supreme Potatoes operates from Firth, Idaho, where it began as a fresh potato packing operation in 1967. The facility expanded into potato dehydration in 1969 and grew into one of North America's dehydration plants. In 2018, Idaho Pacific Holdings acquired the company and continues its tradition of supplying dehydrated potato products worldwide.

The plant produces dehydrated potato flakes, flour, slices, dices, and shreds or hash browns, with ingredient specifications ranging from whole flake to finely milled flours, full cook to low leach, and additive-free clean label options. Foodservice lines include complete mashed potato mixes (blended or agglomerated), scalloped and au gratin casseroles, and seasoned or unseasoned hash browns. An in-house R&D team develops custom formulations, while packaging runs cover poly pouches, gabled cartons, #10 tins, kraft bags, polyethylene bulk sacks, and bulk rail or truck shipments. Private labeling is available for most foodservice and retail items.

Customers span foodservice distributors, retail brands, and industrial ingredient users across North America. The company sources Russet varieties such as Burbank, Norkotah, and Ranger from Idaho's Snake River Plain, leveraging the region's soil, water, and climate for consistent year-round supply.

Idaho Supreme Potatoes emphasizes its diverse production capabilities and certifications—GFSI, Orthodox Union kosher, and IFANCA halal—as the foundation for meeting varied technical and regulatory requirements.
